Wylie | Turrell Verl "Terry" Wylie (August 20, 1927 – August 25, 1984) was an American scholar, Tibetologist, sinologist, and professor, known as one of the 20th century's leading scholars of Tibet. Wylie founded the Tibetan Studies program at the University of Washington, the first such program in the United States. Frederick Starr, a research professor at Johns Hopkins University's School of Advanced International Studies.
